metadata.title: Contribute — Gazetta
metadata.description: How to contribute to Gazetta: agents welcome, what the maintainer reviews, how fast PRs get an answer, and where to start.

content.title: Contribute to Gazetta
content.subtitle: Gazetta is open source under the MIT license. People and coding agents are both welcome to pick up an issue and open a pull request.

content.body:
Use your coding agent if you like: a PR from an agent is reviewed like any other. The repository's AGENTS.md gives agents the layout, every command and the conventions.

Issues labelled ready-for-agent are ready to start: they say what happens, what should happen and how to check it, so a person or an agent can pick one up without asking first. Issues without it still need a decision or more information.

Most PRs are reviewed by AI reviewers and checked by the tests, the live check and undo. A PR that touches these paths also waits for the maintainer, even when the reviewers approve it:

  • Auth and permissions: packages/gazetta/src/auth/, packages/gazetta/src/admin-api/middleware/
  • Storage and the worker: packages/gazetta/src/providers/, packages/gazetta/src/workers/, packages/gazetta/src/public-site-path.ts
  • Workflows and bots: .github/workflows/, bots/

content.heading: How fast PRs get an answer

content.body: Every PR gets a first response within 2 days. That's a reply, not a merge: a review, a question or a pointer to what's missing.

GitHub's contribute page lists the open good first issues, always up to date. Not sure what to pick? Ask in Looking for something to work on?

CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to pick an issue, make the change and what happens after you open a PR.

Each feature's decisions are recorded in a design doc under .claude/rules/ (design-*.md). An issue that names a feature points at its doc. If your change seems to need a different decision, ask on the issue first.
Run Gazetta from main with its starter site. You need Node.js 22.22.2 or later in the 22 line, or Node.js 26.

content.code:
git clone https://github.com/gazetta-studio/gazetta-studio.git
cd gazetta-studio
npm install
npm run dev

content.body: Then open localhost:3000/admin to edit the site; localhost:3000 shows it.
Thank you to everyone who has contributed code, issues, reviews and ideas. See them all on GitHub's contributors page.
